_doc: The journey apps: the one list /journey, its doorman and `journey.py launch` read (skills/journey/journey.py).
name: what the canvas calls the app. scopes: the comment box's choice, or null for none.
checkout: the app's journey checkout (env's machines/claude-sessions names the same folder for `@claude on main journey-<app>`).
canvas: the folder the app publishes its canvas into; it is the page of the app's webcompanion session (kind journey, slug = the app).
features: where the feature ids come from. gherkin: a journey.feature's Scenarios as slugs (@skip kept); command: argv that prints [{id, name, skip}] as JSON.
run: argv that runs features and publishes them, in the checkout; {features} is the chosen ids, nothing for every feature.
after: argv run once the run ends, whatever its result (null for none). env: added to the run's environment; {checkout} is the checkout.
results: the folder, relative to the checkout, whose <feature>/manifest.json the run writes (status, finishedAt, boards, error).
